library.pt_320:r_14732e96f6c1bb50.text:
A science bureau official of the New Government.
A patient man who sees any hardship through to the end no matter the odds, he previously served as the helmsman of Dai-Gurren.
When the Team Dai-Gurren members departed for space, he once again took the helm of Arc-Gurren.

library.pt_320:r_76ffafc69d14df8c.text:
A science bureau official of the New Government.
A patient man who sees any hardship through to the end no matter the odds, he previously served as the helmsman of Dai-Gurren.
When the Team Dai-Gurren members departed for space, he once again took the helm of Arc-Gurren, and later of the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ as well.

library.pt_320:r_ab7c5853bdd941c7.text:
A science bureau official of the New Government.
He once served as a lookout aboard Dai-Gurren, but now works a desk job; constant all-nighters have left him with permanent bags under his eyes. On top of that, his lack of exercise these days has left him considerably heavier.
When the Team Dai-Gurren members departed for space, he continued to support them from behind the scenes, working as hard as ever as an operator.

library.pt_320:r_56897ccd1076cd0d.text:
Deputy Supreme Commander of the New Government.
He met $$シモン$$ and the others when they passed through Adai Village on their journey, and joined Team Gurren. Raised by the strict Priest Magin, he grew up smart and earnest. Always calm and able to see the big picture, he was a rare voice of common sense amid the chaotic, unruly Team Dai-Gurren, and often gave advice to $$シモン$$ and the others.
After $$カミナ$$'s death, he supported $$シモン$$ as Gurren's pilot, and had more than enough spirit to earn his place in Team Dai-Gurren.
These qualities have only sharpened with time, and since Supreme Commander $$シモン$$ has little head for politics, $$ロシウ$$ now single-handedly manages the New Government's day-to-day affairs.

library.pt_320:r_86bc9ea66d94ad19.text:
Deputy Supreme Commander of the New Government.
He met $$シモン$$ and the others when they passed through Adai Village on their journey, and joined Team Gurren. Raised by the strict Priest Magin, he grew up smart and earnest. Always calm and able to see the big picture, he was a rare voice of common sense amid the chaotic, unruly Team Dai-Gurren, and often gave advice to $$シモン$$ and the others.
After $$カミナ$$'s death, he supported $$シモン$$ as Gurren's pilot, and had more than enough spirit to earn his place in Team Dai-Gurren.
These qualities have only sharpened with time, and since Supreme Commander $$シモン$$ has little head for politics, $$ロシウ$$ now single-handedly manages the New Government's day-to-day affairs.
When the Human Extermination System activated, he made the agonizing decision to place the blame on $$シモン$$ in order to quell the public's unrest. As a leader, he tried every means to keep humanity alive, even reviving his former enemy $$ロージェノム$$ as a bio-computer and attempting to escape Earth aboard the excavated Arc-Gurren.
When he eventually realized the path he had taken was wrong, he tried to take his own life to atone. But $$シモン$$ and $$キノン$$ rushed to his side and talked him out of it. He saw $$シモン$$ and the others off as they departed for the final battle against the Anti-Spiral, and after the fighting ended and $$シモン$$ vanished, he continued as a leader, devoting the rest of his life to the advancement of humanity.

library.pt_320:r_5563664b3279f149.text:
Aide to $$ロシウ$$, the New Government's Deputy Supreme Commander.
Like $$シベラ$$ and others, he belongs to a younger generation than the Team Dai-Gurren members who fought in the war against the Spiral King, and tends to view the people of $$シモン$$'s generation (aside from $$ロシウ$$) as outdated.

library.pt_320:r_2a5948e1e1788d6c.text:
Aide to $$ロシウ$$, the New Government's Deputy Supreme Commander.
Like $$シベラ$$ and others, he belongs to a younger generation than the Team Dai-Gurren members who fought in the war against the Spiral King, and tends to view the people of $$シモン$$'s generation (aside from $$ロシウ$$) as outdated.
In truth, as a child he had witnessed their valiant deeds broadcast around the world by Guame, and deep down he had always admired Team Dai-Gurren.

library.pt_320:r_bf9f25a487016d80.text:
An operator in the New Government's Defense Operations Room.
Like $$ギンブレー$$ and others, she belongs to a younger generation than the Team Dai-Gurren members who fought in the war against the Spiral King.
She accurately tracked and directed the response to Mugannn's appearance in $$カミナ$$ City.

library.pt_320:r_11fbce70b1dd8316.text:
An operator in the New Government's Defense Operations Room.
Like $$ギンブレー$$ and others, she belongs to a younger generation than the Team Dai-Gurren members who fought in the war against the Spiral King.
Her skill in accurately tracking and directing the response to Mugannn's appearance in $$カミナ$$ City was recognized, and she was entrusted with operator duties aboard both Arc-Gurren and the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.

library.pt_320:r_383d72c9efe6ac0a.text:
The third-born of the 'Black Siblings,' known for her charming fang.
She met $$カミナ$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter. After joining Team Dai-Gurren, she became a gunner on Dai-Gurren's third bridge alongside $$キヨウ$$, and later piloted her own Gunmen, Kiyalunga, putting up a fight that put men to shame.

library.pt_320:r_5a1fa7b92354b07f.text:
The eldest daughter of the 'Black Siblings.' Her maiden name was Bachika.
She met $$シモン$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter. After joining Team Dai-Gurren, she became a gunner on Dai-Gurren's third bridge alongside $$キヤル$$, and later piloted the Dayakkaiser. She also had a talent for hand-to-hand combat, and once held her own against a Beastman unarmed.
Cheerful and nurturing, she was more of a mother figure to her siblings than simply the eldest sister.
She initially had a crush on $$カミナ$$, but after the war against the Spiral King ended, she married $$ダヤッカ$$. In time, she gave birth to their daughter, $$アンネ$$, the fruit of their love.

library.pt_320:r_31ddf09c4b8b2c55.text:
The eldest daughter of the 'Black Siblings.' Her maiden name was Bachika.
She met $$シモン$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter. After joining Team Dai-Gurren, she became a gunner on Dai-Gurren's third bridge alongside $$キヤル$$, and later piloted the Dayakkaiser. She also had a talent for hand-to-hand combat, and once held her own against a Beastman unarmed.
Cheerful and nurturing, she was more of a mother figure to her siblings than simply the eldest sister.
She initially had a crush on $$カミナ$$, but after the war against the Spiral King ended, she married $$ダヤッカ$$. In time, she gave birth to their daughter, $$アンネ$$, the fruit of their love.
When Team Dai-Gurren set off for the final battle against the Anti-Spiral, she saw her husband $$ダヤッカ$$ off with a smile.

library.pt_320:r_e663b6800ab69081.text:
The second-born of the 'Black Siblings,' she met $$カミナ$$ and the others while working as a Beastman hunter.
Easygoing, shy, reserved, and earnest, her personality was unusual both among her siblings and within Team Dai-Gurren, but she faced battle with the same fighting spirit as everyone else.
After the New Government was formed, she became secretary to Deputy Supreme Commander $$ロシウ$$. Her personality changed so much that she could be called cold, a change that surprised even her brother $$キタン$$.
Understanding the burden $$ロシウ$$ carries, she has given up everything to support him and carry out her duties.

library.pt_320:r_212131bc0ffb22e3.text:
The daughter of $$ダヤッカ$$ and $$キヨウ$$.
She was born as their first child, but her birth pushed humanity's total population past one million, and so, ironically, her arrival became the very trigger that activated the Human Extermination System.

library.pt_320:r_ad3d8363fa541d11.text:
The indomitable, ferocious leader of Team Gurren.
An overwhelmingly forceful man, he powers through anything with sheer spirit and momentum, kicking reason aside to make the impossible happen.
His recklessness was legendary: he once faced down a Gunmen armed with nothing but a sword. He went on to steal a Gunmen bare-handed and pilot it on the spot, and drove Lagann into Gurren's head to declare a 'combination,' then made it a reality, displaying his free-spirited, wild nature at every turn.
Yet his fighting spirit, force of will, and conviction to see anything through gave him tremendous charisma. When he left Giha Village, his only companions were $$シモン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$, but he drew in everyone he met, eventually building Team Dai-Gurren into a great force.
He and $$ヨーコ$$, both strong-willed, never stopped bickering over trivial things. Still, they cared for each other, and before the final battle against Chimyulf they finally opened their hearts and shared a kiss. He boasted, 'I'll pay you back tenfold when I get back,' but a mistake by $$シモン$$ during the battle proved the trigger for a fatal wound. With his last ounce of strength he scolded $$シモン$$ and passed his soul on to him, then burned away to pure white.
Both his way of living and his way of dying left their mark on countless people, and even on the Beastmen.

His recklessness was legendary: he once faced down a Gunmen armed with nothing but a sword. Yet his fighting spirit, force of will, and conviction to see anything through gave him tremendous charisma. When he left Giha Village, his only companions were $$シモン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$, but he drew in everyone he met, eventually building Team Dai-Gurren into a great force.
He and $$ヨーコ$$, both strong-willed, never stopped bickering over trivial things. Still, they cared for each other, and before the final battle against Chimyulf they finally opened their hearts and shared a kiss. He boasted, 'I'll pay you back tenfold when I get back,' but a mistake by $$シモン$$ during the battle proved the trigger for a fatal wound. With his last ounce of strength he scolded $$シモン$$ and passed his soul on to him, then burned away to pure white.
Both his way of living and his way of dying left their mark on countless people, and even on the Beastmen.
When Team Dai-Gurren was trapped in the multiverse by the Anti-Spiral, he appeared before $$シモン$$ and $$ヨーコ$$ and gave each of them the push they needed.

library.pt_320:r_dd4041e1c50d0eff.text:
A pig-mole who is both $$シモン$$'s pet and his best friend.
Small but energetic, he usually rides on $$シモン$$'s shoulder, though he has also been spotted burrowing into $$ヨーコ$$'s cleavage.
His tail grows back after being cut off, making him a reliable emergency ration as well. He is said to be quite delicious and highly nutritious, and once revived $$シモン$$ and $$カミナ$$ in an instant when hunger left them unable to fight properly.

library.pt_320:r_e3035716995f78c9.text:
A pig-mole who is both $$シモン$$'s pet and his best friend.
Small but energetic, he usually rides on $$シモン$$'s shoulder, though he has also been spotted burrowing into $$ヨーコ$$'s cleavage.
His tail grows back after being cut off, making him a reliable emergency ration as well. He is said to be quite delicious and highly nutritious, and once revived $$シモン$$ and $$カミナ$$ in an instant when hunger left them unable to fight properly.
His body is also a mass of Spiral Power, and by releasing his stored Spiral Power as Spiral Energy, he proved himself a true member of Team Dai-Gurren.

library.pt_320:r_30a1f2784f7afd1b.text: A mysterious existence bent on wiping out every living thing that possesses Spiral Power.

library.pt_320:r_057431e0fa86aeec.text:
An existence bent on wiping out every living thing that possesses Spiral Power.
In truth, it is a collective of thought-bodies belonging to the Anti-Spiral race, who sought to eradicate the Spiral races in order to prevent the 'Spiral Nemesis' said to be brought about by Spiral Power.
It was once a Spiral race itself, but out of fear of the Spiral Nemesis, it sealed away its own kind on its homeworld.
It wields power great enough to be called the universe itself, and having no physical form, it cannot be seen. It is also skilled in psychological attacks, trapping its targets in a multiverse to sap their will to fight, or fighting them with matched strength and instilling absolute despair through victory.
In the end, it was defeated by the Spiral Power of $$シモン$$ and the others. It vanished, leaving behind the words: 'protect this universe, no matter what.'

library.pt_320:r_a1c6a50c5934205b.text:
The 'Third Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-01. Age 14.
Summoned by NERV, the special agency headed by his father $$ゲンドウ$$ as Supreme Commander, he boards the all-purpose humanoid decisive weapon, the artificial human Evangelion, and fights the Angels with the fate of the world at stake.
From then on he lives with $$ミサト$$ at her apartment and attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
At first, his introverted nature, low self-esteem, and status as an EVA pilot leave him isolated as a new transfer student, and he clashes with classmates like $$トウジ$$. But through the battles against the Angels, he opens his heart to them and builds real friendships. Guided and encouraged by $$ミサト$$ in her role as guardian, he slowly grows as a person.
He initially hates piloting EVA and clashes with $$ゲンドウ$$ over it, but as he matures, his feelings on the matter begin to change.

library.pt_320:r_6420320351cb07d3.text:
The 'Third Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-01. Age 14.
Summoned by NERV, the special agency headed by his father $$ゲンドウ$$ as Supreme Commander, he boards the all-purpose humanoid decisive weapon, the artificial human Evangelion, and fights the Angels with the fate of the world at stake.
From then on he lives with $$ミサト$$ at her apartment and attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
At first, his introverted nature, low self-esteem, and status as an EVA pilot leave him isolated as a new transfer student, and he clashes with classmates like $$トウジ$$. But through the battles against the Angels, he opens his heart to them and builds real friendships. Guided and encouraged by $$ミサト$$ in her role as guardian, and through his interactions with the First Child $$レイ#333$$ and the Second Child $$アスカ$$, he slowly grows as a person.
He initially hates piloting EVA and clashes with $$ゲンドウ$$ over it, but as he matures, his feelings on the matter begin to change. However, the appearance of $$第９の使徒$$ becomes the catalyst for their relationship deteriorating beyond repair.
Even so, faced with an even harder situation, $$シンジ$$ resolves to fight for what matters most to him.

library.pt_320:r_a704982ca36262dc.text:
The 'First Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-00.
She attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1, in the same class as $$シンジ$$, Year 2 Class A.
A quiet girl who shows almost no emotion, much about her past remains a mystery. The one person she opens her heart to is $$ゲンドウ$$, with whom she converses with a smile and shares meals.

library.pt_320:r_04092c87b7d61acb.text:
The 'First Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-00.
She attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1, in the same class as $$シンジ$$, Year 2 Class A.
A quiet girl who shows almost no emotion, much about her past remains a mystery. The one person she opens her heart to is $$ゲンドウ$$, with whom she converses with a smile and shares meals.
But through the battles, she gradually begins to change, showing emotion to $$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$. After finding the miso soup $$シンジ$$ made for her delicious, she starts practicing cooking so she can host a meal for the Ikari father and son.
However, all of this comes to nothing with the appearance of $$第９の使徒$$.

library.pt_320:r_1f714c57bf555a91.text:
The 'Second Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-02.
Born in Germany, she is an ace of the Euro Air Force with the rank of Captain.
A genius at piloting EVA, her attachment to Unit-02 runs deeper than mere fondness; in her own words, it is 'the only place in the world where I belong.'
Strong-willed by nature, she expresses her feelings bluntly. But underneath that, she is delicate and awkward, and often masks it by acting tough.
Proud of her status as an EVA pilot, when she first arrives in Japan she openly looks down on $$シンジ$$, whose selection criteria seem unclear, dubbing him 'Daddy's Boy,' and on $$レイ#333$$, calling her 'Teacher's Pet.'
She normally attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1, in the same class as $$シンジ$$, Year 2 Class A.

library.pt_320:r_f5f2bcd93bd48c0b.text:
The 'Second Child,' who pilots EVA Unit-02.
Born in Germany, she is an ace of the Euro Air Force with the rank of Captain.
A genius at piloting EVA, her attachment to Unit-02 runs deeper than mere fondness; in her own words, it is 'the only place in the world where I belong.'
Strong-willed by nature, she expresses her feelings bluntly. But underneath that, she is delicate and awkward, and often masks it by acting tough.
Proud of her status as an EVA pilot, when she first arrives in Japan she openly looks down on $$シンジ$$, whose selection criteria seem unclear, dubbing him 'Daddy's Boy,' and on $$レイ#333$$, calling her 'Teacher's Pet.'
She normally attends Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1, in the same class as $$シンジ$$, Year 2 Class A.
After the battle with the Eighth Angel, she grows closer to $$シンジ$$, calling him 'Baka $$シンジ$$' and allowing him to call her '$$アスカ$$.'
She also gradually comes to understand $$レイ#333$$ better, and takes her place in the EVA Unit-03 activation test at Matsushiro. But during the test, Unit-03 is infiltrated by an Angel and identified as hostile by NERV. $$シンジ$$, sent out to intercept, refuses to fight, but the unit is annihilated by Unit-01, which has been taken over by the dummy plug.
Afterward, due to the possibility of mental contamination, she withdraws from the front lines.

library.pt_320:r_87279fd33a271875.text:
An EVA pilot.
Born in England, she belongs to the Euro Branch of the special agency NERV.
Known for her red-framed glasses and a speech habit of tacking 'nya' onto the ends of sentences. She has an optimistic personality, but $$加持$$ calls her a 'problem child.'
At the Bethany Base, she pilots the provisional EVA Unit-05 to fight the Third Angel, self-destructing the unit to annihilate it.
She later visits Tokyo-3, where she sniffs out the faint scent of L.C.L. clinging to $$シンジ$$ and nicknames him 'NERV's little puppy.' Her words and actions are eccentric, and much about her remains a mystery.

library.pt_320:r_0a4d6877d8f4096b.text:
Chief of Section 1, Operations Division, Tactical Operations Department at the special agency NERV. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel. Age 29.
She is the field commander in the battles against the Angels, taking command of operations in place of $$ゲンドウ$$ or $$冬月$$ when they are absent. She burns with a fierce determination to destroy the Angels, though the reasons remain unclear.
On duty, her strong sense of responsibility makes her strict with herself and others, and she is bold enough to carry out operations that sometimes seem reckless. Off duty, however, she is basically cheerful and caring by nature. Her private life is a mess, and she rarely cooks or cleans.
She acts as a guardian figure to $$シンジ$$, letting him live at her apartment along with her pet hot-spring penguin $$ペンペン$$, watching over his growth as someone who understands him, sometimes strict and sometimes gentle.
She has known $$リツコ$$ since their school days.

library.pt_320:r_ef7c88b0e040d6fc.text:
Chief of Section 1, Operations Division, Tactical Operations Department at the special agency NERV. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel at first, later promoted to Colonel. Age 29.
She is the field commander in the battles against the Angels, taking command of operations in place of $$ゲンドウ$$ or $$冬月$$ when they are absent. She burns with a fierce determination to destroy the Angels, though the reasons remain unclear.
On duty, her strong sense of responsibility makes her strict with herself and others, and she is bold enough to carry out operations that sometimes seem reckless. Off duty, however, she is basically cheerful and caring by nature. Her private life is a mess, and she rarely cooks or cleans.
She acts as a guardian figure to $$シンジ$$, letting him live at her apartment along with her pet hot-spring penguin $$ペンペン$$, watching over his growth as someone who understands him, sometimes strict and sometimes gentle. $$アスカ$$ later joins this household as well.
She has known $$リツコ$$ and $$加持$$ since their school days, and was once $$加持$$'s lover.

library.pt_320:r_fef25d47eb3d79a7.text:
A member of Section 1, Technology Division, Technical Development Department at the special agency NERV. Age 30.
A scientist in charge of the 'E Project,' whose goal is the development of the Evangelions.
She approaches everything with intellect and rationality. However, she can also be somewhat inflexible, and $$ミサト$$ describes her as 'someone who doesn't get jokes.' The same holds true on duty, where she often clashes with $$ミサト$$'s bold tactics.
Still, she and $$ミサト$$ have known each other since their school days, and despite their differences, they recognize each other as friends.

library.pt_320:r_29d64c58903fd62a.text:
Supreme Commander of the special agency NERV. Age 48.
While leading NERV in the fight against the Angels, he secretly advances the Human Instrumentality Project on $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s orders.
He is $$シンジ$$'s father, but his uncompromising manner toward his son means their relationship is far from good.
Always cold and severe, he never reveals his true intentions. The one exception is his relationship with $$レイ#333$$, with whom he converses and smiles, and for whom he shows open emotion, even rushing to help her when she is endangered during an experiment.
He occasionally visits the grave of his late wife, Yui.

library.pt_320:r_f6e52d9c7e25f873.text:
Supreme Commander of the special agency NERV. Age 48.
While leading NERV in the fight against the Angels, he secretly advances the Human Instrumentality Project on $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s orders.
He is $$シンジ$$'s father, but his uncompromising manner toward his son means their relationship is far from good.
Always cold and severe, he never reveals his true intentions. The one exception is his relationship with $$レイ#333$$, with whom he converses and smiles, and for whom he shows open emotion, even rushing to help her when she is endangered during an experiment.
He occasionally visits the grave of his late wife, Yui, and once even brought $$シンジ$$ along.
As the fighting continues, he gradually begins to offer words of approval to $$シンジ$$, which pleases him. $$レイ#333$$, hoping to bring father and son closer together, plans a meal for the two of them, but the incident in which Unit-03 is infiltrated by an Angel becomes the catalyst for their relationship deteriorating beyond repair.

library.pt_320:r_be97c8cfca3c2c26.text:
Vice Commander of the special agency NERV.
Someone who understands $$ゲンドウ$$, he assists him as an equal, and at times takes command of operations against the Angels in his place.
He rarely shows emotion, but upon seeing the site of the $$セカンドインパクト$$, he lets slip his true feelings: 'It's too painful to look at.'
In his free time, he can often be seen solving shogi puzzles.

library.pt_320:r_efb209faadb3c4c1.text:
A member of Section 1, Technology Division at the special agency NERV. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
She assists $$リツコ$$, working on the 'E Project,' whose goal is the development of the Evangelions.

library.pt_320:r_8a8bc6ce528509a8.text:
A member of Section 1, Operations Division at the special agency NERV. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
An operator at Headquarters Operations Command, he assists $$ミサト$$ by analyzing the state of battle.

library.pt_320:r_e9ffd76569a8c47d.text:
A member of Section 1, Intelligence Division, Investigation Department at the special agency NERV. Rank: Second Lieutenant.
He handles communications and data analysis.

library.pt_320:r_392be6d719fd14a0.text:
Chief Inspector of the special agency NERV.
He comes to Tokyo-3 from the Euro Branch, assigned to Headquarters. He acts on special orders and is well-connected to all manner of underground information.
Easygoing and hard to pin down, he also has an unpretentious side, such as working in the fields alongside $$シンジ$$.
He has known $$ミサト$$ and $$リツコ$$ since their school days.

library.pt_320:r_45a72397e840609d.text:
Chief Inspector of the special agency NERV.
He comes to Tokyo-3 from the Euro Branch, assigned to Headquarters. He acts on special orders and is well-connected to all manner of underground information.
Easygoing and hard to pin down, he also has an unpretentious side, such as working in the fields alongside $$シンジ$$.
He has known $$ミサト$$ and $$リツコ$$ since their school days, and was once $$ミサト$$'s lover.

library.pt_320:r_8f0b297c09befbd0.text:
A mysterious secret organization advancing the 'Human Instrumentality Project' in accordance with the Apocrypha of the Dead Sea Scrolls.
Its members appear in the guise of monoliths within the 'Audience Chamber' and issue orders to $$ゲンドウ$$.

library.pt_320:r_dd671e2a5dc1d8a1.text:
A mysterious secret organization advancing the 'Human Instrumentality Project' in accordance with the Apocrypha of the Dead Sea Scrolls.
Its members appear in the guise of monoliths within the 'Audience Chamber' and issue orders to $$ゲンドウ$$.

library.pt_320:r_e792cbbcc7949c31.text:
A mysterious secret organization advancing the 'Human Instrumentality Project' in accordance with the Apocrypha of the Dead Sea Scrolls.
Its members appear in the guise of monoliths within the 'Audience Chamber' and issue orders to $$ゲンドウ$$.

library.pt_320:r_262d92c4e7bce1ba.text: A mysterious boy stationed at the lunar Tabgha Base.

library.pt_320:r_5194d82288626b91.text:
A mysterious boy stationed at the lunar Tabgha Base.
His words and actions suggest he somehow already knows $$シンジ$$.

library.pt_320:r_cb98f291d5a022d1.text:
A student in Year 2 Class A at Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
He always wears a tracksuit and speaks in a Kansai accent.
He and $$シンジ$$ start off on bad terms, as $$トウジ$$ lashes out in anger after his sister is injured when caught up in a battle, but the two reconcile after $$トウジ$$ witnesses $$シンジ$$ fighting the Angels with everything he has.
From then on, he and $$ケンスケ$$ become good friends with $$シンジ$$.

library.pt_320:r_8530df6ec595d1af.text:
A student in Year 2 Class A at Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
A dedicated military otaku whose hobby is photographing weapons, he envies $$シンジ$$ and the other EVA pilots.

library.pt_320:r_2f9d9cf8c692b4b0.text:
A student in Year 2 Class A at Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
A dedicated military otaku whose hobby is photographing weapons, he envies $$シンジ$$ and the other EVA pilots.
As $$トウジ$$ puts it, he is 'a guy who's honest about his own desires'; during an evacuation order issued in response to an Angel attack, he talks $$トウジ$$ into sneaking out of the shelter with him so he can watch the battle with his own eyes. $$シンジ$$ saves them both during that battle, and $$ケンスケ$$ becomes his friend alongside $$トウジ$$.

library.pt_320:r_545ec6ebcc68d780.text:
A student in Year 2 Class A at Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
Serious and responsible, she keeps the class in order as its representative. She is also considerate of others, such as inviting the somewhat isolated $$アスカ$$ to eat lunch with her.

library.pt_320:r_07cdb71c1b3f9536.text:
A hot-spring penguin kept by $$ミサト$$ as a pet.
He lives in his own compartment inside the refrigerator, and drinks a beer after his bath.
Hot-spring penguins are an endangered species today, but were once numerous before the $$セカンドインパクト$$.

library.pt_320:r_baaa20477c49e982.text:
A teacher at Tokyo-3 Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
He is also the homeroom teacher of Year 2 Class A, $$シンジ$$'s class.

library.pt_320:r_edb424c83ceb395c.text:
A student at the private $$アッシュフォード学園$$'s upper school. Age 18.
While serving as vice president of the student council, he also indulges in somewhat frivolous pastimes, such as playing chess for money. In truth, he was $$ルルーシュ$$ vi Britannia, the Eleventh Prince and Seventeenth Heir to the Holy Britannian Empire.
Having met the mysterious girl $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ during the Shinjuku Incident, $$ルルーシュ$$ received the $$ギアス$$ of 'Absolute Obedience' in exchange for granting her wish, and turned to rebel against the world. It was a rebellion meant to build a world where his beloved sister $$ナナリー$$ could live and smile.
Combining his brilliant mind and superb strategic eye with the power of $$ギアス$$, $$ルルーシュ$$ absorbed the resistance group of $$エリア１１$$ and formed the Black Knights. He steadily built up their strength until they could eventually fight Britannia on equal terms.
However, during the Black Rebellion, the decisive battle for Japan's liberation, $$ナナリー$$, who was in a sense his very reason for fighting, was abducted, and he abandoned the battlefield. Searching for $$ナナリー$$, $$ルルーシュ$$ made his way to Kamine Island, where he confronted his former best friend $$スザク$$. As a result, his identity was exposed, his existence denied, and he was dragged before the Emperor.
There, $$ルルーシュ$$ learned that his father Charles also wielded $$ギアス$$, and was struck by a $$ギアス$$ that rewrites memories, reverting him to the state before he became Zero, and further, into the memories of a mere nobleman's son.
In this way, $$ルルーシュ$$ forgot both that he had been Zero and that he had ever had a sister named $$ナナリー$$, and lived a peaceful school life alongside his false brother, Rolo.
But after little more than a year, that peace came to a sudden end with the appearance of $$カレン$$ and $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
Regaining the memories that had been sealed by $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and becoming Zero once more, $$ルルーシュ$$ used a series of schemes to found the United Federation of Nations, a coalition to rival Britannia.
Yet in the course of the fighting, $$ルルーシュ$$ lost Shirley, lost $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ (who lost her memories and was no longer the $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ he had known), and lost $$ナナリー$$, and Schneizel's scheming cost him even his place within the Black Knights; in the midst of fleeing, he lost Rolo as well.
Having lost everything, $$ルルーシュ$$ resolved never to return and entered the World of C, where he confronted his father and the mother he had believed dead. Told by his parents of their plan to merge all of humanity's consciousness into one, he rejected it outright, and together with a $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ who had regained her memories, erased both his father and mother from existence.
He then ascended to the throne as Emperor of Britannia, standing as the enemy of the world against the Black Knights and his beloved sister $$ナナリー$$.
Having won the final battle against Schneizel and the Black Knights, $$ルルーシュ$$ finally seized control of the world. But he was then struck down by Zero, who appeared before him, in truth $$スザク$$ in disguise.
It was all part of a scheme devised by $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$, who both wished for a better tomorrow, along with their collaborators. This Zero Requiem was completed with $$ルルーシュ$$'s death, and the world entered a new era.

library.pt_320:r_f1cd3220177a5310.text:
The masked persona $$ルルーシュ$$ adopted to hide his true identity.
He first appeared before the public to rescue $$スザク$$, who had been accused of assassinating Clovis, and from then on staged one miracle after another, becoming a symbol of resistance against Britannia.
After the Black Rebellion, Zero vanished for nearly a year while $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories were sealed, but when $$ルルーシュ$$'s memories returned, so did Zero, appearing before the people once more.
From then on, he pulled off even greater feats, single-handedly rescuing comrades about to be executed, granting a million Japanese citizens asylum in the Chinese Federation, and founding the United Federation of Nations, and became a leading figure of the anti-Britannia movement.
However, Schneizel's scheming exposed both $$ギアス$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true identity, forcing a break with the Black Knights.
But Zero appeared once more and struck down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, who had by then seized control of the world. In truth, this Zero was $$スザク$$, who had plotted the Zero Requiem together with $$ルルーシュ$$: by having Zero strike down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, all the hatred concentrated upon the Emperor vanished, and the world entered a new era.
From then on, $$スザク$$ carried on $$ルルーシュ$$'s will, devoting the rest of his life to being Zero.

library.pt_320:r_746a968f67038888.text:
The son of Genbu Kururugi, the last Prime Minister of Japan, and $$ルルーシュ$$'s childhood friend. Age 18.
He killed his own father, Genbu, in an attempt to end the war between Japan and Britannia. Wracked with guilt, he sought out death by enlisting in the Britannian military, fighting to change Britannia from within. But upon learning that his sworn enemy Zero was in truth his best friend $$ルルーシュ$$, he captured $$ルルーシュ$$, who had abandoned the battlefield during the Black Rebellion, on Kamine Island.
By handing $$ルルーシュ$$ over to Emperor Charles, he earned the position of Knight of Seven among the Emperor's personal Knights of the Round.
After Euphemia's death and $$ルルーシュ$$'s betrayal, his sense of responsibility and strength of will grew even stronger, and he began making cold, ruthless decisions in the field.
Upon hearing news of Zero's return, he is posted to $$エリア１１$$ to assist the new Viceroy, $$ナナリー$$. He re-enrolls at $$アッシュフォード学園$$ to investigate $$ルルーシュ$$, but has trouble pinning down his true identity, since $$ルルーシュ$$ has already co-opted the intelligence bureau.
As $$ルルーシュ$$ lost allies one after another in the fighting, he finally admitted to $$スザク$$ that he was Zero and asked for his help in protecting $$ナナリー$$. The two nearly joined forces, but Schneizel's scheming and a resulting misunderstanding drove them apart once more.
During the Second Battle of Tokyo, cornered by $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$, the 'Live' $$ギアス$$ $$ルルーシュ$$ had once placed on him activates, and in self-defense he fires the tactical weapon Freya, mounted on the Lancelot. Having taken countless lives through his own actions, $$スザク$$ abandons kindness and begins pursuing results alone.
He joins Schneizel's coup in order to become Knight of One. Heading to Kamine Island to assassinate Charles, $$スザク$$ there learns $$ルルーシュ$$'s true intentions. Becoming his collaborator, he begins calling himself Knight of Zero, sworn to $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.
In the final battle, he fights $$カレン$$'s $$紅蓮聖天八極式$$ to a mutual standstill. Afterward, he casts aside his life as $$枢木スザク$$, and becomes Zero to complete the Zero Requiem, striking down $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

library.pt_320:r_11a0b1ae039260b5.text:
Born to a Britannian noble father and a Japanese mother, she has been a member of the Black Knights since its founding. Age 18.
Energetic and unwilling to lose, she harbors deep anger toward Britannia for conquering her homeland, Japan.
She met Zero during her time in the resistance, and after witnessing the many miracles he brought about, came to trust him more and more. Her exceptional skill piloting Knightmare Frames was soon recognized, and after the Black Knights were formed, she was appointed captain of the Zero Squad, Zero's personal guard. Piloting her crimson signature unit, the Guren Type-02, she charged through the front lines as the Black Knights' ace.
During the Black Rebellion, she pursued the Lancelot to Kamine Island, where she learned that Zero's true identity was $$ルルーシュ$$. She fell into a state of shock for a time, effectively abandoning $$ルルーシュ$$, but her trust in Zero never fully disappeared.
After a year in hiding, she carried out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and others to confirm both her own feelings and $$ルルーシュ$$'s true intentions, and succeeded in reviving Zero.
From then on, with skill said to rival that of the Knights of the Round, she and her beloved Guren won victory after victory on the battlefield, but was captured after running out of energy in her fight against $$星刻$$.
Taken prisoner, $$カレン$$ was handed over to $$スザク$$, and remained off the battlefield for a long time until $$咲世子$$ rescued her during the Second Battle of Tokyo.
When Zero, having been driven out of the Black Knights, became $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, she reunited with him at a negotiation and gave him a farewell kiss.
In the final battle, she fought $$スザク$$ to a near-mutual defeat, but ultimately claimed victory. Afterward, though condemned to execution as a traitor, $$カレン$$ witnessed the Zero Requiem unfold before her eyes.
Having come to understand the true intentions of both $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$, $$カレン$$ went on to live in the new world $$ルルーシュ$$ had wished for.

library.pt_320:r_7ca1c58fb19a3703.text:
A girl who possesses an immortal body and the 'Code,' a power that grants $$ギアス$$.
Her name, written '$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$,' is pronounced 'C-Two.'
Under a contract to grant her own wish in exchange, she gave $$ルルーシュ$$ the $$ギアス$$ of 'Absolute Obedience.'
During the Black Rebellion, she sinks $$ジェレミア$$'s Siegfried into the sea, prepared for mutual destruction, and escapes. She then goes into hiding to evade pursuit, but a year later, she carries out Operation Hien $$フォウ$$ with $$カレン$$ and others to reclaim Zero, awakening $$ルルーシュ$$'s sealed memories and reviving him as Zero.
The one wish stipulated by their contract was for her to pass on the immortal Code to someone else so that she herself could finally die. She lent $$ルルーシュ$$ her aid only to wait for his $$ギアス$$ to grow strong enough to reach that point.
Before $$ルルーシュ$$ could earn that qualification, Charles offered to grant her wish himself, but $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ refused. To protect $$ルルーシュ$$, and to fulfill her true wish, she sealed away the immortal Code along with her own memories.
Having lost her memories, she reverted to the state she was in before receiving $$ギアス$$, but was revived after being persuaded by Marianne, who had been hiding within $$アーニャ$$, and went with her to Kamine Island. There, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ watched the entire confrontation between Charles and $$ルルーシュ$$ unfold, and in the end rejected Charles and the others.
Afterward, she remained at the side of $$ルルーシュ$$, now Emperor, as his shield, and took part in the final battle as well.
Having witnessed the Zero Requiem through to the end, she set off for parts unknown, carrying with her the memories of her fellow conspirator, $$ルルーシュ$$.

library.pt_320:r_6faca1d535cf4900.text:
A military officer of the Chinese Federation who combines outstanding combat ability with political skill. Age 24.
His name is properly pronounced in Chinese as '$$黎星刻$$.'
Deeply loyal, he swore a pact of Eternal Harmony with Tianzi after she once saved his life. However, his body is being consumed by a serious illness.
He served as an escort to Gao Hai, the Chinese Federation's Consul-General to $$エリア１１$$, but purged Gao Hai after $$ギアス$$ caused him to place Zero above the nation's interests.
Upon returning to the Chinese Federation once a new Consul-General was chosen, he plotted a coup against the Grand Eunuch who ruled the Federation, for the sake of the Tianzi he revered. Having had his life saved by the young Tianzi as a child, $$星刻$$ could not accept the Grand Eunuch's methods of using her as a tool for his ambitions while indulging in nothing but his own self-interest.
He launched the coup to prevent Tianzi's political marriage, but she was ultimately taken into Zero's custody. He briefly submitted to the Grand Eunuch in order to reclaim Tianzi and rescue his captured subordinates, but upon learning the Grand Eunuch intended to sacrifice her as a pawn, he struck the Grand Eunuch down with Zero's help.
From then on, he allied with the Black Knights, and served as commander-in-chief of the Black Knights within the United Federation of Nations military.
In the final battle, he exploited a brief opening to storm the Avalon and successfully freed Tianzi and the others who had been held hostage by $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

library.pt_320:r_644f104d7b6808e8.text:
A Britannian military officer from the prestigious Gottwald family, bearing the title of Margrave. Age 29.
As leader of the 'Purist Faction,' which held that the Britannian military should be made up of ethnic Britannians only, he plotted to seize control of the army, but was brought down by Zero's schemes. The scandal Zero fabricated at the time, 'Orange,' left him scorned by that nickname ever after.
Later, in a bid to turn his fortunes around, he was struck by the Guren Type-02's radiant wave surger during the battle of the Narita mountains, and while wandering near death was recovered by researchers under Bartley. His body was then modified to serve as a test subject.
He awakened in an unstable state during the Black Rebellion. His obsession with Zero spiraled out of control, and he confronted Zero while piloting the Siegfried, but sank into the sea alongside the Gawain, piloted by $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
Afterward, the $$ギアス嚮団$$ recovered him along with the Siegfried. Further modifications gave him the power of the '$$ギアス$$ Canceller,' capable of nullifying $$ギアス$$. He used this power to corner $$ルルーシュ$$, but his true aim was to confirm $$ルルーシュ$$'s real intentions. Despite the repeated modifications, $$ジェレミア$$'s loyalty to the imperial family never faded, and he swore his allegiance to $$ルルーシュ$$, son of the beloved Empress Marianne.
From then on, he fought hard as $$ルルーシュ$$'s loyal subordinate, continuing even after $$ルルーシュ$$ ascended to the throne as Emperor.
After the Zero Requiem was completed, he took up running an orange farm. By his side was $$アーニャ$$, once his enemy in battle.
